# Igor / Poliklot — full-stack product engineer

> Personal portfolio of Igor / Poliklot, a full-stack developer and frontend lead who ships complex digital products end to end and uses AI agents to accelerate engineering work without delegating architecture, quality, or release responsibility.

- [English version](https://poliklot.ru/en/): Capabilities, delivery approach, technology stack, and commercial experience.
- [Материалы](https://poliklot.ru/articles/): Статьи и практические инструкции о разработке, тестировании и выпуске цифровых продуктов.
- [Как пройти обязательное тестирование в Google Play](https://poliklot.ru/articles/mobile-app-testing/): Пошаговая инструкция для новых личных аккаунтов — 12 тестировщиков, 14 дней непрерывного участия и заявка на доступ к рабочей версии.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Poliklot): Public engineering profile and repositories.
- [Résumé](https://hh.ru/resume/ebe2b012ff0834a84e0039ed1f6d6b526b584f): Full professional résumé on hh.ru.

## Key facts

- 8+ years of commercial software development since 2018.
- Frontend lead with experience coordinating a team of five.
- Master's degree in Software Engineering, completed in 2024 at Kuban State Technological University.
- Works across product frontend, backend and data, DevSecOps, AI engineering, mobile development, quality, and release processes.
- Uses AI agents for parallel investigation, implementation, testing, documentation, and validation while retaining human ownership of decisions and outcomes.
